text: 国务院新闻办公室将于2026年10月19日（星期一）下午3时举行新闻发布会，请商务部部长助理袁晓明和工业和信息化部、文化和旅游部有关负责人介绍加快推进科技兴商有关情况，并答记者问
text_en: The State Council Information Office will hold a press conference at 3 p.m. on Monday, October 19, 2026, and has invited Assistant Minister of Commerce Yuan Xiaoming and relevant officials from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism to introduce the situation on accelerating science and technology-driven commerce and answer questions from reporters
